counterexample: The patch does not compile: self._advanceToNextDown() fails with error 9582 because _advanceToNextDown is private and cannot be called with member syntax. Even if that call compiled, the current tick would still be the start tick when the search begins. With tick spacing 10, one position [100, 200), start 100 and end 50, the walk would return nothing instead of [100].

summary: Sets the current tick to the end tick and clears the word for an empty range, loads the start word through an if and else whose branches are identical, and calls _advanceToNextDown with member syntax. The code does not compile, and even if it did the search would still start strictly below the start tick.
